title: Otome game release
author: VanillaGamesVN
selftext:
I just released the demo of my visual novel (otome game), it takes place in an academy/college for wizards.  
Feel free to check it, you can play it on the web browser or on mobile (android devices).

[https://vanillagamesvisualnovel.itch.io/academy-of-wisgon](https://vanillagamesvisualnovel.itch.io/academy-of-wisgon)

comments.author: Katwazere
comments.body: It looks like ai. I suggest that you redo all the art with a dedicated art style, like using a standardised lora and model so that it's consistent, that's my opinion based on just seeing the screenshots

replies.author: q-ue
replies.body: Yeah this artstyle is kinda creepy

replies.author: Katwazere
replies.body: They are also blurry, like they were genned at 512 then scaled up to the size

replies.author: VanillaGamesVN
replies.body:
The idea was to have a style direction only possible with ai and the issue with using a lora or any popular standardised model was making something too similar to what's already been done (often too anime like).

I did my best to try to make it look like the most consistent with this realistic art style but it is still experimental after all and I can understand that it might look off. 

I have to add it is not apparent on the screenshots but all the characters have a wide variety of facial expressions that eases that inconsistent effect.

Also it is blurry on purpose because it is thought to be played on mobile and also the backround was meant to be fully animated, I do have one backround that's animated but currently there's no ai model that offers a way making loopable backround videos. In brief, the game is made on very low resolution on purpose.
